subject.title: Hosted Molty (usemolty.com): model selector doesn't persist — API always receives dotted id claude-opus-4.8[Błąd]:

question: Should this be handled as hosted Molty deployment/state repair, or is there a reachable OpenClaw UI/gateway source path that can still emit dotted full Anthropic ids from Brain & Keys?
rationale: Current main's normal UI and gateway model-selection path appears to use catalog ids correctly, but the reporter's hosted screenshots show the deployed service ignoring provider/model selection and the hosted layer may be outside this repository.

options.title: Verify Hosted Molty First
options.body: Inspect the deployed Brain & Keys save/request payload and stored state, then migrate stale hosted selections or redeploy the corrected catalog/session path if that is the failing layer.

options.title: Patch Source Regression
options.body: If hosted Molty uses this source path, add a focused UI/gateway regression that prevents labels or dotted full Anthropic ids from reaching provider calls.

options.title: Route To Hosted Support
options.body: If usemolty.com owns this behavior outside OpenClaw source, keep this as ops/support tracking until hosted proof confirms recovery.

recommendation.title: Verify Hosted Molty First
recommendation.body: Inspect the deployed Brain & Keys save/request payload and stored state, then migrate stale hosted selections or redeploy the corrected catalog/session path if that is the failing layer.
